'''Ancient Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. As of version 1.9.18, Ancient Parasites are considered deprecated, scheduled for a massive rework. Because of this, they're not considered in the Hierarchy. 

Ancient Parasites are currently a heavy [[:Category:Work In Progress Content|Work In Progress]]. 

Ancient Parasites are a Tier uniquely compromised of [[Bosses]].

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Ancient Parasites do not spawn naturally as of 1.10.

=== Weakness ===
Like all Parasites, Ancients present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).
